after_estimates.sentence: After the estimates were seen, rows with `age` below `18` or not recorded were excluded as adults.

sentences: The table was read through the `dietary` lens.
The analysis was declared for `inference`: associations are estimated with their uncertainty.
Column roles were set for `2` columns: exposure `fiber`; covariate `age`.

Rows missing any predictor were dropped (a complete-case analysis); complete cases give unbiased coefficients only if whether a value is missing does not depend on the outcome, given the predictors (Groenwold et al. 2012; White & Carlin 2010).
No rows were held out: every analyzed row estimates the coefficients, and no cross-validated score is reported under inference: the declared model is reported by its estimates.
One model family was chosen: linear regression.
plan.text: This is the analysis plan as declared in TurboTab before any estimate was displayed; it was locked on 2026-11-04 at 13:44:52.074108 UTC, before the first estimate was shown. It records what was declared in the software and when; it is not a registration with any outside registry, and the analyst may have seen the data. Its SHA-256 over canonical JSON (keys sorted, no spaces, UTF-8) is 6dd29ed9b6b06eaa7a2951fdb841ebefff48d2ff79d9b94ebd6dff7ffc76aa31: the same decisions give the same bytes, so the hash can be cited in an external registration. 1 decision was made after the estimates were seen, listed with it and marked so in the methods.
